title: Rhetoric in Classical Historiography: Four Studies
author: Woodman, A. J.
subject: classics; classical studies; ancient history; historiography; rhetoric; Roman history; Greek history; Thucydides; Cicero; Sallust; Livy; Tacitus; Latin literature; Croom Helm; Areopagitica Press
description: First edition, 1988: the Areopagitica Press issue for the United States (ISBN 0-918400-07-4) of the Croom Helm printing, comprising Woodman's four studies on Thucydides, Cicero, Sallust and Livy, and Tacitus. Hardcover in black cloth with bright gilt lettering to the spine, in the original cream dust jacket, not price-clipped. The jacket has minor creasing at the head; the cloth at the head of the spine is lightly rubbed, the upper corners are slightly bumped, and there is light grey soiling to the top edge of the text block. Internally clean and unmarked, with no inscription or bookplate, and the binding tight and square.
